page.notes: The right part of every line is cut off by the edge of the scan, so line ends are missing. Lines with brace-shaped labels ("Sequi", "Ara", the braces beside the Saturnus, Lunonis and Iovis entries) are rendered as plain paragraphs. The word after "Præneste de" is illegible. Some words in the Ficus Ruminalis entry are unclear. Only the left part of the page is transcribed here. The line numbers 10 to 50 stand beside the column. The rotated label "Deorum. iii." is in the left margin. The reading "Bithynico" and "Savarrone" are uncertain, and the scan is faint in places. The page is cut off at the top and bottom, so no page number is shown.
